    Purchase a new laptop in Bắc Ninh by browsing deals at major retailers offering free delivery or quick store pick-up. Popular options include the Lenovo V15 ($675) at FPT Shop or a gaming MSI Katana ($1,655) via CellphoneS. 
    Best Local & Online Retailers: 
    • CellphoneS: Offers extensive models, HSSV (student) discounts, and 0% installments. You can also explore their Laptop Gaming hub if you need a machine for rendering and gaming.
    • FPT Shop: Known for nationwide warranties and massive flash sales, including a dedicated section for Gaming & Đồ họa.
    • HACOM: Perfect if you want to pick up your laptop from a physical store.
    • Lenovo Vietnam: Direct-to-consumer purchases with custom configurations and student pricing. 
    Local Tech Hubs & Service: 
    • You can visit main shopping streets or direct brand stores in nearby central Bắc Ninh or take a short ~25km drive to major IT centers in Hanoi (like Lê Thanh Nghị street or Thai Ha street) for the widest variety of hardware and in-person inspections.
